description: This file contains utility functions related to environment variables, including helpers to interpret boolean-like values, retrieve environment variables with default fallbacks, determine the authentication provider, and check the configuration status of a service (Supabase).

methods.name: isTrue(value)
methods.description: Converts a boolean-ish value to a boolean, recognizing strings like 'true', 'yes', 'on', and '1'.

methods.name: getEnv(name, defaultValue = undefined)
methods.description: Retrieves an environment variable value, falling back to a default if not set or empty. Handles build-time replacements in certain frameworks.

methods.name: getAuthProvider()
methods.description: Determines the authentication provider based on environment variables, defaulting to 'mock'.

methods.name: isSupabaseConfigured()
methods.description: Checks whether the necessary environment variables for Supabase configuration are set and non-empty.
